views.caption: Seed 7, star 33, night 1: a held tracking drift, a cosmic ray, a hot pixel and an end-of-night flare on one curve. Only the field detector names the drift.
Seed 42, star 24, night 2: median_residual's two fragments inside a flare it had already bounded were booked as false alarms until the scorer learned to call them corroborating.
Seed 7, star 7, night 1: the tracking drift as the field detector sees it, spanning an hour past the ramp because its causal baseline absorbs the step.
